notes.title: Maltiplay mode release!!
notes.notes:
2018/07/17 and Vecpoly Game mounted a multi-play mode on "Beginner'sGame".
It's connected at the same time now, several, even 20 people, and, it's being done, but a player will go to increase as well as increase the number of simultaneous connections from now on.
A war of 1on1 is developed by a multi-play mode.
There is also a possibility that a mode will be increased from now on, so please enjoy yourself!

notes.title: Update is coming!
notes.notes:
The Beginner'sgame update was released on June 23, 2018 at Japan time.
We have implemented high score mode as a major change.
This feature is not a full-fledged implementation because of the preview function, but by implementing a function that can be called the origin of this game, it was a game that can be fun and play long time.
This is the main change.
Thank you in the future.
